title: CAS Cell Annotation Collection (local extension)
description: A cell-set-level annotation collection shaped after the Cell Annotation Schema (CAS, general + BICAN) with local extensions: a per-cell-set 'composition' slot (the cell-set-level generalisation of CxG's cell-level descriptor fields), cell_count/cell_ratio on transferred annotations (reused for integration provenance), labelset 'rank'/'role', and a retained 'source' block carrying atlas-paper provenance for the report workflow. See planning/mockup_cas_cxg_annotations_2026-06-24.md.

matrix_file_id.description: Resolvable target for the cell-by-gene matrix: a URL or filename of the h5ad/zarr the annotations describe. Deliberately looser than CAS's namespace:accession form so a plain zarr/h5ad URL or path is valid.

source.description: Local extension: atlas-paper provenance (DOI, subatlas papers) consumed by the report workflow. Not part of CAS core.

labelsets.description: Annotation keys. One labelset per cell-type obs column.

annotations.description: Per-cell-set annotations, each tied to a labelset + cell_label.

Labelset.description: A CAS labelset (annotation key). Local extension adds 'role'.

name.description: Name of the annotation key (obs column).

role.description: Local extension: functional role assigned by classify-obs-fields. Free text (open) with recommended values; drives routing, not enumerated as a hard constraint.

Annotation.description: One annotated cell set. Closed set (additionalProperties:false) — arbitrary obs goes in author_annotation_fields, descriptor distributions in composition.

labelset.description: Name of the labelset this annotation belongs to.

cell_label.description: Verbatim author label for the cell set.

cell_set_accession.description: Stable id for this cell set, independent of cell_label.

parent_cell_set_accession.description: Accession of the cell set that subsumes this one (hierarchy); null for root cell sets.

n_cells.description: Local extension: number of cells in the set.

transferred_annotations.description: CAS slot reused for integration provenance (author labels inherited from contributing datasets). See TransferredAnnotation.

composition.description: Local extension: cell-set-level distributions over descriptor categories (the set-level form of CxG cell-level fields).

author_annotation_fields.description: Arbitrary UNMAPPED obs fields, verbatim. Must not duplicate a labelset or a composition category.

TransferredAnnotation.description: A label transferred from another source. CAS-BICAN shape; local extensions add cell_count/cell_ratio, source_labelset, and subatlas_paper. Two flavours share this slot: integration provenance (author label inherited from an integrated subatlas — set subatlas_paper) and computational transfer (an algorithm moved the label — set algorithm_name; any metric/threshold may be noted in comment). source_taxonomy and subatlas_paper may both be set and should then agree (cross-check).

source_taxonomy.description: Identifier of the source taxonomy/dataset the label came from: a CAS taxonomy accession (e.g. CCN20230722), a PURL, or a DOI.

subatlas_paper.description: The contributing subatlas the label was inherited from — a DOI, or a SubatlasPaper.label registered under source.subatlas_papers. If source_taxonomy is also set, the two should agree.

source_labelset.description: Name of the labelset within the source taxonomy/subatlas that the transferred label belongs to.

cell_count.description: Local extension: cells in this set carrying the transferred label.

cell_ratio.description: Local extension: fraction of the set carrying the transferred label (denominator: this cell set).

source_label_cell_count.description: Local extension: total cells carrying this transferred label anywhere in the atlas, not just in this cell set. Lets a consumer compute the reverse share (cell_count / source_label_cell_count) — 'this set captured 12% of the cells the source called X' — which per-set counts alone cannot express, and which separates a split upstream cell type from a renamed one.

Composition.description: Keyed by CxG descriptor category (tissue, development_stage, assay, disease, sex, self_reported_ethnicity, organism) or an open semantic key (e.g. germ_layer) for non-CxG descriptors. Keys are not enumerated; each value is a CompositionCategory.

CompositionCategory.description: The distribution of one descriptor category over the cell set.

author_field_name.description: The original obs column this category came from.

CompositionValue.description: One value in a descriptor distribution. 'author_value' is verbatim; 'value'/'ontology_term_id' are additive mapped forms. Mirrors CxG's per-field pair, one level up.

author_value.description: Verbatim author value (may already be a CURIE).

ontology_term_id.description: Mapped ontology CURIE, e.g. UBERON:0000966, HsapDv:0000048.

AtlasPaper.description: Atlas publication provenance (retained local block, mirrors cell_type_annotation.schema.json).

atlas_name.description: Human-readable atlas name, e.g. 'Human Female Reproductive System Cell Atlas v1'.

links.description: Named external resources for the atlas as an open map of label -> URL/identifier, e.g. {"preprint": "...", "cellxgene": "..."}.

status.description: Ingest route taken for this paper — how its text is reached. Distinct from asta_indexing.band, which is how much of it ASTA holds: a paper can be band 'abstract_only' in ASTA and still status 'local' because a JATS build succeeded.

source_type.description: Where the locally built text came from, when status is 'local'.

AstaIndexing.description: How much of this paper ASTA's snippet index actually holds, measured by one paper-scoped snippet_search (services.asta_indexing). Semantic Scholar's metadata graph and the snippet index are separate systems, so CorpusId presence says nothing about retrievable text — this block is the only record of what is quotable and traversable. Only band 'full' may be served from ASTA.

band.description: 'full' = body text indexed with a bibliography (sections >= 1 and refMentions > 0); 'partial' = indexed but below the observed full-text floor; 'abstract_only' = title/abstract chunks only, no body, no traversable references; 'unindexed' = registered in S2 but zero snippets; 'not_in_s2' = absent from Semantic Scholar entirely.

snippets.description: Chunks returned for the paper-scoped search (its whole indexed set).

chars.description: Total characters of indexed snippet text.

sections.description: Distinct non-null section names — the body-text signal.

ref_mentions.description: Inline reference mentions — the bibliography signal.

probed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the probe; this block doubles as the probe cache.
